patterns.note: A dark, full-width canvas serves as the backdrop for content, featuring centered text blocks and grid-based displays for project cards.
The primary color scheme is high-contrast, with light text on a deep dark background, allowing vibrant, abstract digital art visuals to stand out.
As the user scrolls down, new content sections and individual project cards reveal themselves with a subtle upward slide and fade-in animation as they enter the viewport.
The main navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport throughout the scroll, providing persistent access to site links.
Project cards consistently feature a prominent abstract visual above a concise title and a brief descriptive text.

technique_notes: The site utilizes a full-bleed dark canvas to showcase abstract, often generative, digital art and WebGL-rendered visuals as primary content, including hero elements and project thumbnails, creating an immersive and high-tech aesthetic.
Content sections and individual cards are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, typically involving a subtle upward translation and fade-in effect as they become visible within the viewport.
A sticky navigation bar is implemented at the top of the page, maintaining its position and appearance without transformation as the user scrolls.

design_tokens.type_scale: Balanced sans-serif scale with clear hierarchy; headings are moderately larger than body text, maintaining readability without extreme contrast.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners for all content blocks, images, and buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a balanced grid for content cards.

standout: The site's distinctive feature is its immersive use of abstract, often generative, digital art and WebGL-rendered visuals as core content elements, rather than traditional photography or illustrations. This creates a high-tech, artistic, and sophisticated aesthetic that immediately communicates its focus on innovative digital experiences.
